kind: compatibility planning map, not a global installed-device inventory

device_families.name: Windows laptops / desktops / gaming PCs
device_families.spec_scope: CPU/GPU identity, RAM, disks, battery where present, software inventory, peripherals, supported driver sensors

device_families.name: Windows tablets / convertibles
device_families.status: native; touch layout tested in browser
device_families.spec_scope: Same Windows APIs; sensor and touch support depends on hardware

device_families.name: Windows ARM laptops / tablets
device_families.status: no native ARM build; x64 compatibility not independently tested
device_families.spec_scope: Web tools only by default; x64 app requires compatible OS emulation

device_families.name: Android phones / rugged handhelds
device_families.spec_scope: Reported SoC, GPU driver renderer, RAM, data-volume storage, display, battery, OS thermal severity, visible apps and USB host devices

device_families.name: Android tablets / foldables
device_families.status: same APK; tablet/side-dock paths implemented, physical tablet untested
device_families.spec_scope: Reported Android APIs; app window controls layout, not nationality

device_families.name: iPhone
device_families.spec_scope: Selected-file hashes and reports; no system hardware scan or background antivirus

device_families.name: iPad
device_families.spec_scope: Selected-file hashes and reports, responsive layout; not native OS inventory

device_families.name: Apple silicon MacBook / iMac / Mac mini / Mac Studio
device_families.status: limited source preview; native packaging blocked
device_families.spec_scope: OS/resource observations where APIs support them; no Windows engine parity

device_families.name: Intel MacBook / iMac / Mac mini / Mac Pro
device_families.status: limited source preview; native packaging blocked
device_families.spec_scope: Python/OS observations; host generation and OS version matter

device_families.name: Linux laptops / desktops / workstations
device_families.status: limited source preview; no native release binary
device_families.spec_scope: CPU/RAM/storage, available Linux thermal sensors and USB inventory; optional tools are not all installed

device_families.name: Raspberry Pi / ARM single-board computers
device_families.status: source preview; no Pi hardware test
device_families.spec_scope: Linux/sysfs USB and service/tool discovery; GPIO/sensors require actual attached hardware and adapters

device_families.name: Chromebooks
device_families.requirement: Modern browser; optional compatible Linux environment
device_families.spec_scope: Browser-selected files only; Linux environment is not the whole ChromeOS host

device_families.name: Linux / Windows servers and VMs
device_families.status: source/read-only scope; server enforcement not certified
device_families.spec_scope: Hypervisor-exposed virtual hardware differs from physical host; no inference of underlying components

device_families.name: Android TV / Google TV / set-top boxes
device_families.status: not a tested native TV product
device_families.spec_scope: No remote-control-optimized native interface or universal file picker guarantee

device_families.name: Wearables / smartwatches
device_families.spec_scope: Separate small-screen native app, permissions and sensor adapter required

device_families.name: Routers / NAS / cameras / printers / IoT / OT
device_families.status: agentless research/report target; not installable everywhere
device_families.spec_scope: Authorized inventory only; device-specific agents/protocols needed; no firmware enforcement claimed

limits: No IP geolocation or citizenship inference.
No country geofence in application code; network/legal/distribution availability not verified per country.
English interface, Unicode report text; not fully localized.
Compatibility depends on OS, architecture, permissions, browser and exposed hardware APIs, not a national hardware assumption.
No exhaustive model/vendor catalog or every-device test is claimed.
